findings.title: Exact duplicate rows detected in raw data
findings.statement: The raw dataset contained 12 exact duplicate rows, representing 2.91% of the original 412 records.
findings.recommendation: Remove exact duplicates prior to model training to avoid data leakage and bias.

findings.title: Severe data leakage in refund amount
findings.statement: The refund_amount column separates the target variable churned almost perfectly with an AUC value of 1.0.
findings.recommendation: Exclude refund_amount from feature sets for predictive modeling of customer churn.

findings.title: Missing values and hidden tokens in region
findings.statement: The region column had 10.68% missing values along with 44 hidden-missing tokens and case variants.
findings.recommendation: Standardize categorical text formatting and apply missingness indicators or mode imputation.

findings.title: Heavy right-skewness and outliers in revenue
findings.statement: Revenue exhibits a high skew of 19.21 and contains 76 IQR outliers across the distribution.
findings.recommendation: Apply logarithmic transformations or robust scaling to mitigate the influence of extreme revenue values.

findings.title: Target class imbalance in dataset
findings.statement: The target variable churned shows a class balance of 75.24% for no and 24.76% for yes.
findings.recommendation: Account for class imbalance using appropriate evaluation metrics like ROC-AUC or balancing techniques.

findings.title: Data quality score improvement post-cleaning
findings.statement: The data quality score increased from 79.7 out of 100 in the raw dataset to 100.0 out of 100 in the cleaned dataset.
findings.recommendation: Use the fully cleaned dataset for downstream exploratory analysis and predictive modeling.

narrative.headline: Dataset cleaned and prepared for churn prediction after resolving critical data leakage and quality issues.
narrative.executive_summary: The raw dataset had a quality score of 79.7 out of 100 before cleaning and improved to 100.0 out of 100 after cleaning. We removed 12 exact duplicate rows, representing 2.91% of the original 412 records, and dropped the refund_amount column because it caused severe data leakage with an AUC value of 1.0. The target variable churned exhibits a class balance of 75.24% for no and 24.76% for yes. Additionally, we handled 10.68% missing values in the region column and addressed 76 IQR outliers in revenue, which has a skew of 19.21.
next_steps: Train baseline classification models using the cleaned dataset of 400 records.
Account for the target class imbalance of 75.24% to 24.76% during model training.
Evaluate feature importance while ensuring no additional data leakage occurs.
Monitor the handling of revenue outliers and their impact on model performance.

cleaning.description: Turn missing-value tokens ('N/A', '-', '?', 'null', '') into real missing values.
cleaning.changes: Changed 44 values in 'region', all now missing (e.g. 'N/A' → (missing)); changed 74 values in 'quantity', all now missing (e.g. '-' → (missing); '?' → (missing); 'N/A' → (missing)); changed 412 values in 'notes', all now missing (e.g. '' → (missing)).
cleaning.rationale: Standardize all hidden missing tokens across the dataset.

cleaning.description: Convert text dates in any common format to dates.
cleaning.changes: Converted 'order_date' to dates; changed 278 values in 'order_date' (e.g. '22 Dec 2025' → 2025-12-22; '04 May 2025' → 2025-05-04; '12/02/2025' → 2025-12-02).
Converted 'unit_price' to numbers; changed 412 values in 'unit_price' (e.g. '$1,192.90' → 1192.9; '$11.60' → 11.6; '$11.40' → 11.4).
cleaning.rationale: Convert currency formatted unit_price to numeric type before outlier operations.

cleaning.description: Convert text numbers to numbers (unparseable -> missing).

cleaning.rationale: Convert quantity and revenue from text to numeric so mathematical operations and imputations can succeed.
